target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, disposable writable VirtIO RedSea fixture
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-redsea-present-current-c161-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-raw-redsea-geometry present
verified: The bounded RedSea fixture mounted as writable D with the expected 128-sector extent and stock filesystem metadata.
Stock DiskCheck returned clean and the TOSMisc DiskCheckAll dispatcher checked D while safely skipping the source-only C volume.
The probe wrote, read back, restored, and re-read the final sector without leaving changes in the fixture.
The guest returned to a working terminal and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: This is a disposable VirtIO fixture test of the generic block and RedSea paths. It does not exercise physical Pi SDHCI or FAT32.
